rules.name: Blood Ritual
rules.description:
Range: LOS
Level: 2
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: The Warp Lord freely pours his own blood for the glory of the Dark One, to bring forth his demonic minions.
Effect: Cast on a friendly model. If successfully cast, the Spellcaster suffers a wound with no saves of any kind allowed. For each wound the target model inflicts in Close Combat this turn, place a small marker next to the Spellcaster. You cannot have more than 6 markers. The Spellcaster can use the markers when casting any Summoning Ritual, but they must all be used at once. Each marker lowers the level of the Summoning Ritual by 1.

rules.name: Possession
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 7
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 4
Description: The decaying influence of the Warped Lord is projected onto the unsuspecting enemy soldiers, playing with their fears and vanities, forcing them to do his dark bidding.
Effect: Pick an enemy model that has not been Activated this turn, is no further than 20” from the Spellcaster and is within LOS. The target can make a normal Spell Saving Roll. If the Spell is successfully cast, the Spellcaster gains control of the possessed model until the end of the turn. Treat it as one of your own models and as an extra Activation. You cannot force possessed models to go outside the Game Board Edge.

rules.name: Summon Demon
rules.description:
Range: Summon
Level: 8
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 5
Description: The Warped Lord taps into the Warp Realms, calling forth vile creatures from the beyond to do his dark bidding.
Effect: If successfully cast, summon 1 Infernal creature from the 2nd Circle and place it within 4” of the Spellcaster. The summoned demon acts as a separate Warband. If you summon the same type of Demon again, it will join the first Demons Warband.

rules.name: Vortex
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 7
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 5
Description: The Warped Lord opens a direct portal to the Twilight Realms, pouring their unrestrained dark energy onto the battlefield.
Effect: If the ritual is successfully cast, pick a point within 20” and LOS. Put the centre of the Vortex Template (Small Explosion Template) on the desired point and move it X inches in a direction chosen by the caster. X is the difference between the successful roll and the required value to cast the Spell. Every model that is touched by the template, at any point in its movement, must take a Dam 3 Psychic Attack. If this is survived they will need to take a Dex test. If the Dex test is failed the model becomes Dazed. If any model moves through a Vortex Template during their Activation, they automatically receive a Dam 3 Psychic Attack. If this is survived they will need to take a Dex test. If the Dex test is failed the model becomes Dazed. At the end of the End Phase roll for Deviation and move the template accordingly, dividing the distance by 2. Repeat the process during the End Phase of each subsequent turn until the vortex moves off the Game Board. Only 1 Vortex may be in play per player and it cannot be removed willingly. When moving, if the Vortex hits an Impassable Terrain feature, move it around the feature. Your opponent gets to choose the direction of travel unless you spend 1 CP. In that case you can choose.

rules.name: Warp Gate
rules.description:
Range: Self, B2B or 6”
Level: 6*
Type: Instant
Bond Cost: 4
Description: 
Effect: Cast on yourself or at an opposing model up to 6” away. If cast on an opposing model, normal Spell saves are allowed. The level of the Spell may increase due to the base size of the opposing model: 40mm +2, 50mm +3, more than 50mm +4. If successfully cast teleport the target model using a Deviation roll. If, after Deviation, the base of the teleported model is fully inside an Impassable Terrain feature footprint, remove the model as a casualty. If only part of the base is inside Impassable Terrain, then the model takes a Dam 10 hit. If it survives move it out of the Impassable Terrain to the closest legal location. If a Warp Gate has been used to travel by a Spellcaster and cast with Perfect Success, they may regain 1 Wound. You cannot teleport a model outside of the Game Board. The target model is immune to Free Slash attacks until the end of the Spell.

rules.name: Summon Greater Demon
rules.description:
Range: Summon
Level: 12
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 10
Description: The Warped Lord taps into the Warp Realms, calling forth vile creatures from the beyond to do his dark bidding.
Effect: If successfully cast summon 1 Greater Demon from the 3rd Circle and place it within 4” of the Spellcaster. The Summoned demon acts as a separate Warband.

rules.name: Summon Demons
rules.description:
Range: Summon
Level: 11
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 7
Description: The Warped Lord taps into the Warp Realms, calling forth vile creatures from the beyond to do his dark bidding.
Effect: If successfully cast, summon 2 non-Individual or 1 Individual Infernal Creature(s) from the 2nd Circle and place them within 4” of the Spellcaster. Summoned demons act as a separate Warband. If you summon the same type of Demons again, they will join the first Warband.
